{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of test orders: {len(test_orders)}")
print(f"Test order IDs: {test_orders['order_id'].tolist()}")

# Filter out test orders and refunded orders
completed_valid = sales[
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_valid['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}")

# Verify the number of completed orders
print(f"Number of completed orders (excluding test): {len(completed_valid)}")"}
